issue.description:
Plan: docs/plan/plan.md R042 item 6 (commit 75dc46a6; decision record beadrs-691c4fec). Operator-requested 2026-10-28. Evidence comes from a 2026-10-28 sweep of 98 bead-rs workspaces on codinghome (50,819 beads, copies deduplicated) and of transcripts from 2026-08-03 to 2026-10-28 (292,734 bead-related shell commands; regex baselines, not release claims).

Clean-room rule: amend the governing file under research/specs/ first, in its own commit, then implement only from it.

## Evidence
- Operator decision 2026-10-28 (plan R042 item 6): priority, and only priority, becomes editable through an audited operation. This supersedes R037 and ADR-007 for priority only.
- 304 `priority:` labels across 61 workspaces are the workaround.
- The R041 umbrella recorded 44 rejected `update --title|--description|--priority` attempts.

## Scope
- **Spec:** amend research/specs/native-field-guide-v1.md and the R037 remedy text. Add a status note to docs/adr/007-cli-errors-name-the-remedy.md: superseded for priority by plan R042.
- **Command:** `bead update ID --priority N --reason TEXT [--if-revision R]` runs as one transaction.
  - It records a distinct `priority_changed` event carrying old value, new value, actor and reason.
  - The revision increments, the change feed and checkpoint publish, and ready-frontier ordering uses the new value immediately.
- **Claimed issues:** an `in_progress` issue owned by a claimant requires the claim credential, as other claimant mutations do.
- **Errors and no-ops:** `--priority` without `--reason` exits 2, naming the remedy. Setting the same value is a no-op: exit 0, no event.
- Title, description and issue type stay immutable with their R037 remedies.
- `capabilities` advertises `priority_change: true`.

## Ordering
Blocked by beadrs-ab4a2b91, because the claim-epoch credential work gates the same update path.

## Non-goals
Migrating existing `priority:` labels.

## Acceptance
- Tests cover:
  - the event shape;
  - a revision-guard conflict exits 4;
  - the credential is required on a claimed issue;
  - frontier order changes;
  - the same-value no-op;
  - the missing-reason error text;
  - an interchange round trip of the new event;
  - older readers ignore it.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass on the pushed commit.
